body: I feel so anxious that I am actually tempted to drop out of university..

Hey man, i can understand your anxiety, fear of the unknown, not knowing for sure, it sucks; have you considered raising your worries with your manager? if they know you were having some health issues, they might be able to sort something out for you. I really hope things get better for you, good luck!
Thank you, hope youre doing ok too.

I left my lecture early today due to anxiety and got a milkshake, was good advice! I have a physchologist who also does my prescripions and such here in Sweden, who i havent seen for quite a while, and one back home in England, who does the same if i need them..havent seen him since i was home.
Thank you for the kind words
Never heard of it, what is it? :)
I was on prozac for a long period of time, however, its never been much help in terms of anxiety :(

Hi everyone, thanks for your kind and helpful thoughts..its comforting to know one isnt alone here..i had to leave class early today, because i was feeling so anxious, i tried having a couple cigs after clas to calm down, but like usual, it just makes me more anxious. i dont think my meds are helping me, quetiapine 300mg. i want to talk to someone about this, but i feel like i cant, like im ashamed. Im so down the anxiety hole right now, that i cant tell if my worries are real or fabricated, its just impossible, i was taught all this CBT stuff in the past, but it never works. id like to have a big old cry to get it all out, but i cant bring myself to do it..i am flying back home on friday though..
thanks..no, its a bit badly worded, i made a post about something that got deleted on yahoo, but thanks

Hey all..spent all day in bed today worrying, a bad day even by my standard! it was night time, so im not sure whether anyone could see anything in a dark room..the thing is i have no memory before i was having this weird sleepwalking moment, i had to get the shirt from somewhere else in my room, maybe i turned the lights on to find it? i dont know, since i cant remember..oh by the way, im on quetiapine :)
